imp_privacy: Your file is read in this browser and never sent anywhere. PDF only for now; Word (DOCX) is coming in a later version.
imp_privacy_live: Your file is read in this browser and isn't sent itself. Only its text goes out to split it into entries, with your name and contact details masked. PDF only for now; Word (DOCX) is coming in a later version.
imp_err_not_pdf_body: If it's a Word document, save it as PDF first (File → Save as → PDF). DOCX support is coming in a later version.
imp_err_encrypted_body: Save a copy without a password and try again.
imp_err_no_text_title: This PDF has no readable text
imp_err_no_text_body: The text was most likely saved as an image (e.g. a flattened PDF from Canva or a scanned page). Export it again as a PDF with selectable text, or enter your details by hand. Reading text from images (OCR) is coming in a later version.
imp_err_unreadable_body: The file may be damaged or in an unsupported format. Export the PDF again and retry.
imp_err_too_large_body: You can pick a PDF of up to 20 MB.
imp_err_parse_body: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, enter your details by hand.
imp_banner_rules: Entries were split with rules; parsing will be more accurate once AI is connected. Your file wasn't sent anywhere.
imp_banner_ai: AI split the entries; your contact details were masked before sending. Check them before you create the CV.
imp_mismatch: The PDF looks like it's in {detected}, but you're creating the CV in {selected}. Content isn't translated; the CV language sets the section titles and date format.
imp_review_hint: Untick the entries you don't want. Open an entry to fix its fields.
imp_contacts_none: No contact details found; you can add them in the editor.
imp_none_found_body: The text was read but couldn't be split into entries. Copy the text below and paste it into the right fields in the editor.
imp_raw_hint: If parsing missed something, copy it from here.
rv_intro: Checks your CV with rules, the way an ATS (applicant tracking system) reads it. No scores: it tells you what passes, what to fix, and why.
rv_no_cvs: You don't have a CV yet. Start from a template or upload a PDF.
rv_drop_hint: The file is read in your browser. Nothing is sent unless you ask for AI feedback.
rv_ad_hint: Paste the ad text to check whether its keywords appear in your CV.
rv_ad_placeholder: Paste the full job ad here…
rv_empty_title: Choose a CV or upload a PDF
rv_empty_body: The review starts as soon as you choose, and updates on its own as you edit your CV.
rv_kw_note: Rough match: looks for the ad's frequent and technical words in your CV, ignoring suffixes and plurals. It doesn't know synonyms; use the button below for a meaning-based comparison.
rv_kw_ai_body: It also recognises synonyms and abbreviations. The ad and your CV's text are sent only when you ask.
rv_kw_ai_body_demo: For now a small synonym list makes a sample comparison; nothing is sent.
rv_kw_ai_related_hint: The ad's term appears in your CV with different wording. An ATS may look for the exact term; if it fits, use the ad's wording too.
rv_kw_ai_pair: “{term}” in the ad, “{cvTerm}” in your CV
rv_kw_ai_none: No terms were found to compare.
rv_kw_ai_stale: The job ad has changed; compare again for an up-to-date result.
rv_kw_ai_payload_desc: Below is everything this comparison would send.
rv_kw_ai_payload_rules: The job ad is sent as is. In your CV's text, your name, emails and phone numbers, your location, links of yours and your references' names are masked with ⟦…⟧ placeholders; the terms the rule-based comparison found are sent too.
rv_kw_missing_hint: In the ad, not in your CV. If you really know these, add them where they fit.
rv_kw_none: No keywords found in the ad. Make sure you pasted the full text.
rv_kw_all_present: Every keyword from the ad appears in your CV.
rv_text_hint: The PDF's text in reading order. Most ATSs use this order; anything that looks jumbled here looks jumbled to the ATS too.
rv_text_hint_cv: The order your text will be read in once your CV is printed to PDF, template and page breaks included. Most ATSs use this order; anything that looks jumbled here looks jumbled to the ATS too.
rv_ai_body: Feedback on bullet impact, verb choice and fit with the ad. The checks above are rule-based; this feedback comes from AI. Your CV's text is sent only when you ask.
rv_ai_body_demo: For now you'll see sample feedback; nothing is sent.
rv_ai_with_ad: The job ad you pasted is sent too.
rv_ai_empty: There was nothing to comment on.
rv_ai_stale: The job ad has changed; ask again for up-to-date feedback.
rv_ai_payload_desc: Below is everything this feedback request would send.
rv_ai_payload_rules: For your own CV, your name and contact fields are never sent. In the text (an uploaded PDF too), your name, emails and phone numbers, your location, links of yours and your references' names are masked with ⟦…⟧ placeholders and put back only in your browser when the reply arrives. Hidden sections and entries of your own CV aren't sent. The job ad is sent as is.
rv_ai_name_missing: Your name couldn't be found in the PDF, so if it appears in the text it will be sent unmasked. Check “What's sent?” before sending.
rv_ai_name_missing_payload: Your name couldn't be found in the PDF. If it appears in the text, you'll see it below as is, and it will be sent that way.
rv_ai_mock_summary_ok: You have a summary, so readers get who you are in the first lines.
rv_ai_mock_summary_missing: There's no summary. Write two or three sentences on what you do and what you're looking for.

match.countPlural=one: {count} bullet has no numbers. Add a duration, amount or scope to show its impact.
match.countPlural=other: {count} bullets have no numbers. Add a duration, amount or scope to a few to show their impact.

rv_ai_mock_numbers_ok: Your bullets include concrete numbers that show your impact.
rv_ai_mock_weak: There's a weak phrase like “{phrase}”. Use a strong verb that says what you did.
rv_ai_mock_job: The ad emphasises: {terms}. Give concrete examples of these in your experience bullets.
rv_cv_text_ok: Text is selectable and in the right reading order
rv_cv_text_ok_d: CVeditör prints the PDF as real text; it doesn't use images, tables or text boxes. The ATS reads the text in page order.
rv_layout_single_d: Every ATS reads a single column top to bottom.
rv_layout_two_d: This template has the side column read first, then the main column; most ATSs read that correctly. Still, a single column is the safest layout.
rv_layout_side_main_d: Some ATSs mix two columns line by line; main sections such as experience and education belong in the main column. Move this section to the main column in the Appearance tab.
rv_layout_side_long_d: The side column holds {chars} characters of text. Short lists like skills and languages work well there; long text becomes unreadable in an ATS that mixes columns.
rv_name_ok_d: The ATS files the candidate under this name.
rv_name_missing_d: The ATS files the application by name; without one, the CV shows up unnamed. Add your name at the top of your personal details.
rv_headline_ok_d: Recruiters and ATSs match this line against the role first; keep it close to the title in the ad.
rv_headline_missing_d: The headline under your name (e.g. “Frontend Developer”) is the first line matched against the role. Use a title close to the one in the ad.
rv_email_ok_d: The ATS fills the contact field with this address.
rv_email_missing_d: Recruiters usually reply by email, and ATSs tell candidates apart by email.
rv_email_bad_d: If the ATS can't parse this field, your contact details stay empty. Format: name@domain.com.
rv_phone_ok_d: It dials correctly for applications abroad too.
rv_phone_missing_d: Interview invitations often come by phone. Include the country code, e.g. +90 5xx xxx xx xx.
rv_phone_bad_d: 7-15 digits expected; use only +, spaces, hyphens and parentheses. Letters or extra notes stop the ATS from parsing the number.
rv_phone_no_cc_d: If you're applying to a company abroad, start the number with your country code (e.g. +90).
rv_location_ok_d: ATSs can filter candidates by city; your location shows up in that filter.
rv_location_missing_d: Many ATSs filter candidates by city. City and country are enough; no full address needed.
rv_link_bad_d: A broken link can't be clicked and isn't carried into the ATS profile field. No spaces; format: domain.com/path.
rv_link_not_linkedin: LinkedIn field has no LinkedIn address: {value}
rv_link_not_github: GitHub field has no GitHub address: {value}
rv_link_wrong_site_d: The ATS saves this field as that profile. Write the full address: linkedin.com/in/your-name or github.com/your-username.
rv_linkedin_missing_d: Most recruiters check the LinkedIn profile; some ATSs keep this link in a separate field.
rv_links_ok_d: All are valid addresses and clickable in the PDF.
rv_title_unknown: The ATS may not recognise the “{title}” heading
rv_title_unknown_d: ATSs split sections by known headings; entries under an unknown heading may land in the wrong field or be skipped. Standard equivalent: “{suggestion}”.
rv_title_custom_d: Not every ATS recognises custom headings. If the content fits a standard section (Projects, Certificates, Volunteering…), move it there; if not, it can stay.
rv_titles_ok_d: ATSs recognise these headings and sort entries into the right fields.
rv_need_experience_d: ATSs read experience as a separate field and compare it with the ad more than anything else. If you're a new graduate, include internships and part-time jobs.
rv_need_education_d: Many ads require education; if the ATS sees this field empty, you may be filtered out automatically.
rv_need_skills_d: A separate skills list is the easiest way to match the ad's keywords.
rv_essentials_ok_d: The sections ATSs look for as separate fields.
rv_hidden_d: Hidden sections and entries don't go into the PDF. If you hid them on purpose, that's fine.
rv_hidden_none_d: Everything you see in the editor is in the PDF too.
rv_date_no_start_d: The ATS works out experience from dates; an undated entry may not count toward your total experience.
rv_date_no_end_d: If it's ongoing, tick “Ongoing”; if it ended, add the end date. Otherwise the duration can't be worked out.
rv_date_inverted_d: The end comes before the start ({range}). The ATS miscalculates the duration or ignores the entry, and recruiters read it as carelessness.
rv_date_order_d: Recruiters and ATSs expect the most recent entry at the top. Drag the entries to reorder them.
rv_dates_complete_d: Every entry has a start and an end (or is marked ongoing); the ATS can work out durations.
rv_dates_ordered_d: Your most recent experience is on top, visible at a glance.
rv_dates_month_mixed: Some dates have a month, some don't
rv_dates_month_mixed_d: With month: {withMonth}; year only: {withoutMonth}. A consistent format looks tidier and makes durations easier to work out; add the month to all of them if you can.
rv_dates_format_ok_d: All dates are written the same way.
rv_summary_missing_d: A 2-4 sentence summary is the first thing a recruiter reads, and it gives you room to use the ad's keywords naturally.
rv_summary_short_d: Aim for 2-4 sentences: what you do, where you're strongest, the role you're after.
rv_summary_long_d: Recruiters give the summary a few seconds; 40-80 words is usually enough. Leave the detail to your experience bullets.
rv_summary_ok: Summary is a good length ({words} words)
rv_summary_ok_d: Short and readable; it says who you are at a glance.
rv_empty_desc_d: Your recent roles are where the ATS looks for keywords and where recruiters read the most. Write 2-4 bullets on what you did and the result.
rv_empty_ok_d: Your experience from the last five years is described.
rv_paragraph_d: A long paragraph gets skipped when skimming. Split it into bullets so it's easier to read and the ATS sees each task on its own line.
rv_paragraph_ok: Experience descriptions are bulleted or short
rv_long_bullets_d: Bullets over {max} characters don't get read when skimming. One task and its result per bullet; split the rest into another bullet.
rv_pronoun_d: A CV doesn't need “I/my” (“ben/benim” in Turkish); start the bullet straight with a verb: “Led…”, “Built…”.
rv_pronoun_ok_d: Bullets start straight with the work.
rv_numbers_ok_d: Measurable results (percentages, time, people, amounts) make a bullet concrete.
rv_numbers_low_d: Few measurable results. Add numbers where they fit: how much faster, how many people reached, how much saved. Don't make up numbers you don't know.
rv_double_space_d: Double spaces stand out and can break keyword search in some ATSs.
rv_all_caps_d: All-caps lines are hard to read, and some ATSs may take them for headings. Use normal case; bold is enough for emphasis.
rv_caps_ok_d: No line is written entirely in capitals.
rv_bullet_end_mixed_d: Ending with a period: {dot}; without: {noDot}. Pick one style and use it everywhere.
rv_bullet_end_ok_d: All bullets end the same way.
rv_pages_many_d: CVs longer than two pages often aren't read to the end. Shorten old entries and ones unrelated to the ad.
rv_pages_two_d: Two pages is normal if you're experienced; if you're a new graduate, aim for one.
rv_pages_one_d: A length a recruiter can take in at a glance.
rv_photo_en_d: In the US and UK a photo usually isn't expected; some companies screen out CVs with photos to avoid bias. Check what's usual in the country you're applying to.
rv_photo_ok_tr_d: Photos are common in Türkiye. ATSs don't read photos; they don't affect the text.
rv_photo_none_d: No photo; it makes no difference to the ATS.
rv_pdf_text_ok_d: An ATS can read the text in this PDF. See what it sees under “Text the ATS sees”.
rv_pdf_little_d: Part of the text may be embedded as an image (e.g. exported as a picture from a design tool). ATSs don't read text inside images.
rv_pdf_empty_page_d: This page may have been saved as an image; the ATS sees it as blank.
rv_pdf_garbled_d: The text has unrecognised characters (�). The font wasn't embedded properly, so the ATS can't search these words. Export the PDF again from another program.
rv_pdf_mojibake_d: The text has broken letters such as {sample} (e.g. “ý” instead of “ı”). The ATS can't find these words; export the PDF again with a font that supports Turkish characters.
rv_pdf_no_dotless_d: The text looks Turkish but has no “ı” at all; the font may lack the letter or it may have been turned into “i”. The ATS sees “yazilim” instead of “yazılım”.
rv_pdf_spaced_d: Words look split letter by letter (e.g. “E X P E R I E N C E”). This usually comes from wide letter spacing or a poor export; the ATS can't recognise the words.
rv_pdf_chars_ok_d: No broken or unrecognised characters; Turkish letters read correctly.
rv_pdf_interleaved_d: The text jumps between two columns line by line ({switches} switches). The ATS reads it in that order and sentences run into each other. Try a single-column layout.
rv_pdf_columns_d: Columns are read one after the other; most ATSs read that correctly. A single column is still the safest.
rv_pdf_repeated_d: It looks like a header or footer. Some ATSs don't read headers and footers; if your contact details are there, move them into the body.
rv_pdf_repeated_ok_d: No line repeats across pages; everything is in the body.
rv_pdf_email_ok_d: The ATS can fill the contact field with this address.
rv_pdf_email_missing_d: The ATS pulls contact details from the text. If there's no email, or it's inside an image, no one can reach you.
rv_pdf_contact_late: Email isn't on the first page
rv_pdf_contact_late_d: Contact details are expected at the top of the first page; that's where ATSs and recruiters look.
rv_pdf_phone_ok_d: The number can be read as text.
rv_pdf_phone_missing_d: Nothing in the text looks like a phone number. If there is one, it may be inside an image; write it as text with the country code.
rv_pdf_linkedin_ok_d: The address can be read as text: {value}
rv_pdf_headings_ok_d: Found: {list}. The ATS sorts entries by these headings.
rv_pdf_heading_missing_d: ATSs split sections by their headings. If you have this section, use a standard heading on a line of its own.
rv_pdf_dates_none_d: Without dates in experience and education, the ATS can't work out durations.
rv_pdf_dates_mixed_d: Formats found: {examples}. The ATS works out durations more reliably with one format; write them all the same way (e.g. “03/2021 – 12/2023” or “Mar 2021 – Dec 2023”).
rv_pdf_dates_year_d: Some dates look like “{example}”, others are year only. Add the month to all of them if you can.
rv_pdf_dates_ok_d: Dates are written the same way (e.g. “{example}”).
rv_pdf_err_not_pdf_d: Only PDFs can be reviewed. Save the Word document as PDF and try again.
rv_pdf_err_encrypted_d: ATSs can't read password-protected PDFs either. Upload a copy without a password.
rv_pdf_err_no_text_d: This PDF was saved as an image (e.g. a scan or an image export). An ATS can't read anything; export your CV as text or rebuild it in CVeditör.
rv_pdf_err_unreadable_d: The file may be damaged. Export it again and retry; an ATS can't read a damaged file either.
browser_note: This browser isn't Chromium-based. The site works, but for a PDF that matches the preview exactly, use Chrome, Edge or Brave.
not_found_body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have been removed.
list_subtitle: Most recently edited first. CVs are stored only in this browser.
list_empty_body: Pick a template, fill in your details, and your PDF is ready.
delete_body: The CV will be removed from this browser.
delete_undo_hint: For a few seconds after deleting, you can bring it back with "Undo". If you want a permanent copy, export it as JSON first.
backup_reminder_title: Your data lives only in this browser
backup_reminder_never: You haven't made a backup yet. If browser data is cleared, your CVs go with it.
templates_subtitle: Pick a template and fill it with your details. You can switch templates later without losing content.
templates_welcome_body: Pick a template to get started. You can switch templates any time; nothing you write is lost.
templates_more_soon: The person and photo in the gallery are a made-up example. If you don't upload a photo, the template switches to its photo-free layout by itself. Every layout is one an ATS can read.
template_zarif_desc: Centred classic serif on ivory paper, fine rules beside each heading. No colour blocks; the quietest template.
template_panel_desc: A full-height dark column on the left with a round photo; your name and experience get the wide white area.
template_bant_desc: An edge-to-edge colour band with your name in white; a round photo overlaps the band's edge.
template_manset_desc: A huge two-line serif name over a bold rule; the summary reads like a magazine lede.
template_gece_desc: A fully dark page with a fine inner frame, an all-caps name and gold headings.
template_isvicre_desc: Section names in a narrow label column on the left; a light name, a red vertical rule and monospaced dates.
template_cizelge_desc: A timeline down the left edge, a ring for every entry and coloured date tags.
template_cift_desc: No white space: a light left side, a dark right side, your name in white on the dark side.
template_afis_desc: Black and white; a huge all-caps name, highlighter accents and black heading labels.
template_cerceve_desc: A coloured frame around the page, a cream background and italic serif headings.
new_cv_details_desc: Name your CV and choose its language.
new_cv_name_hint: Only you see this; e.g. "General TR" or "Frontend internship EN".
new_cv_language_hint: Section titles and dates are written in this language.
new_cv_start_title: How do you want to start?
start_blank_desc: Start from scratch with example hints in the fields.
start_import_desc: Details from your PDF are split into entries; you check and confirm them.
start_copy_desc: The content is copied and the new template applied.
start_copy_language_note: The CV you chose is in another language. Content is copied as is. For a translated copy, use "Translate to the other language" in the editor's CV menu.
import_pick_body: Only the content is imported; the look comes from the template you chose.
import_found_sample: Entries found (sample data). Untick the entries you don't want.
preview_empty_hint: Your CV takes shape here as you fill in the fields on the right. What you see is exactly what the PDF will look like.
editor_language_hint: CV language: section titles and dates are in this language
editor_missing_body: This CV may have been deleted or created in another browser. CVs stay only in the browser they were created in.
editor_broken_body: The saved data couldn't be read. You can try restoring a backup from Settings.
mobile_note: Open the CV on a computer to edit it. On your phone you can preview it and export a PDF.
db_version_changed: CVeditör was updated in another tab. Reload this page so your changes keep saving.
db_upgrade_blocked: CVeditör is open in another tab with an older version. Close or reload that tab to finish the update.
pages_hint: Your CV is longer than one page. That's fine, though most employers prefer a single page.
pdf_hint: Choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog
pdf_pending_suggestions: Accept or reject the pending suggestions first.
pdf_confirm_title: An entry is longer than one page
pdf_confirm_desc: {count} entries don't fit on a single page. If you export the PDF, they'll be split between bullets; no text is cut off.
pdf_confirm_check: I'm fine with these entries being split between bullets.
ux_pdf_confirm_desc_one: One entry doesn't fit on a single page. If you export the PDF, it'll be split between bullets; no text is cut off.
ux_pdf_confirm_check_one: I'm fine with this entry being split between bullets.

match.countPlural=one: {count} entry is longer than a page
match.countPlural=other: {count} entries are longer than a page

oversized_body: Entries normally aren't split; one that doesn't fit on a page is split between bullets. Click to shorten:
clipped_body: Even a single paragraph doesn't fit on the page; that paragraph may be cut off. Split it into bullets.
ph_experience_desc: What did you do, and what came of it? Start each bullet with a strong verb and add numbers where you can.
ph_education_desc: Optional: key courses, a capstone project or scholarships
ph_project_desc: What does the project do, what did you build, and with which technologies?
ph_summary: Say who you are and what you're looking for in two or three sentences. Be specific: your field, your strength, your goal.
date_inverted: End date is before the start date.
photo_hint: Optional. Common in Türkiye; usually not expected in the US and UK.
photo_visible: Shown on the CV. You can turn it off in the Appearance tab.
photo_hidden: Uploaded but hidden on the CV. You can turn it on in the Appearance tab.
photo_shown_toast: Photo now shown on the CV
dnd_instructions: Press Space or Enter to pick it up. While moving, use the up and down arrows to change its position; press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
section_delete_body: The section is removed along with all its entries.
section_delete_hint: For a few seconds after deleting, you can bring it back with "Undo"; Ctrl+Z works too. If you just don't want it on the CV, hiding the section is enough.
section_empty: No entries in this section yet.
copy_to_cv_desc: "{name}" is added to the same section of the CV you choose.
copy_to_cv_none: No other CVs. Create a new CV first.
tr8_translate_intro_en: Creates an English copy of this Turkish CV; this CV stays as it is. Template and appearance stay the same; dates and section titles switch to English on their own.
tr8_translate_intro_tr: Creates a Turkish copy of this English CV; this CV stays as it is. Template and appearance stay the same; dates and section titles switch to Turkish on their own.
tr8_translate_rules: Names of people, companies, products and technologies, links and email aren't translated. You can check and fix every field before saving.
tr8_translate_demo: For now only a few dictionary words are translated; everything will be translated once AI is connected.
tr8_translate_review_desc: {changed} of {total} fields changed. Fix anything you need; it's saved when you confirm.
tr8_translate_keep_label: Don't translate {field}, keep it as is
tr8_translate_empty: This CV has no text to translate. A copy is still created; dates and section titles change on their own.
tr8_translate_error: Translation failed. Try again in a moment.
tr8_copy_translate_hint_en: The CV you chose is in English. The entry is translated to English; you'll see the translation before it's added.
tr8_copy_translate_hint_tr: The CV you chose is in Turkish. The entry is translated to Turkish; you'll see the translation before it's added.
tr8_copy_linked: This CV has a linked entry
tr8_copy_link_note: The two entries stay linked; if you change one later, you can update the other from here.
tr8_copy_review_desc: Will be added to "{name}". Fix anything you need.
tr8_copy_nothing: This entry has no text to translate; it'll be added as is.
ap_template_hint: Switching templates doesn't lose any content.
ap_colors_hint: Pick one of the template's matching colour sets or choose your own. If a colour is too light to read, the text version darkens automatically.
ap_ink_note: Dark background: fine on screen and in the PDF, but uses a lot of ink when printed on paper.
ap_font_hint: The body text font; your name and headings keep the template's own font. All support Turkish characters and are embedded in the PDF.
ap_columns_hint: Keep the side column short; contact details always sit in the name header.
ap_columns_only_two: This template has two columns. Choose which sections go in the side column.
ap_photo_none: Until you upload a photo, the CV prints without one; the dashed box in the preview only shows where it goes. Upload it in your personal details on the Content tab.
ap_order_hint: Drag the handle (⠿), or focus it and move with Space and the arrow keys. The order changes on the Content tab too.
ph_award_desc: Why did you win it, and among how many? Keep it short and concrete.
ph_volunteer_desc: What did you do, and who did it help? e.g. weekly coding workshop for 40 students
ph_custom_desc: Describe this entry briefly: what, where, and what came of it?
browser_note_safari: Safari may delete data for sites you haven’t visited in 7 days. Back up your CVs as JSON regularly (Settings), or use Chrome, Edge or Brave.
settings_browser_safari: Safari may delete data for sites that haven’t been visited in 7 days (Intelligent Tracking Prevention). Your CVs live only in this browser, so back them up as JSON regularly or use a Chromium-based browser.
print_menu_oversized: This CV has an entry longer than one page; you need to confirm before saving the PDF. Close this window and the confirmation will open.
print_menu_pending: You have pending suggestions. Accept or reject them first, then press “Export PDF”.
print_menu_not_ready: The preview isn’t ready yet. Close this window and print again in a few seconds, or press “Export PDF”.
ai_placeholder: What would you like to change in your CV? e.g. "Make my experience bullets more measurable"
ai_preview_note: Preview: nothing is sent; the suggestions are samples.
ai_no_suggestions: Nothing to change in this scope. Try wording your request differently.
ai_no_suggestions_demo: No sample suggestions for this scope.

match.countPlural=one: {count} suggestion not applied: the field changed after it was made
match.countPlural=other: {count} suggestions not applied: the field changed after they were made

match.countPlural=one: {count} suggestion removed because the field changed
match.countPlural=other: {count} suggestions removed because the field changed

ai_note_tidy: Bullet starts and endings made consistent; weak phrasing replaced with strong verbs.
ai_note_sample: Sample suggestion: the summary is more specific.
ai2_note_sample_remove: Sample suggestion: this entry could go.
ai2_note_sample_add: Sample suggestion: a new entry was added.
ai2_note_sample_bullet: Sample suggestion: a measurable bullet was added.
ai2_error_invalid: The response wasn't in the expected format, so it wasn't shown. Try again.
ai2_error_network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
ai2_error_rate: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
ai2_error_unknown: The request couldn't be completed. Try again.
ai2_error_unauthorized: The request wasn't sent because no password was entered. Try again and you'll be asked for it.
ai2_error_unavailable: AI isn't available right now; the daily limit may have been reached. Try again later.
ai_auth_desc: AI features are password-protected. Enter the password and your request carries on.

ai2_payload_desc: Below is everything that would be sent for this request and scope.
ai2_payload_rules: Your name field is never sent. In the text, your name, email addresses, phone numbers, your location, links of yours (including any that contain your name) and your references' names are masked with ⟦…⟧ placeholders and put back only in your browser when the reply arrives. Other links (e.g. project URLs) are sent as is. Contact details are sent only if the request is about them.
ai2_payload_demo: A sample provider is running right now: this data isn't sent anywhere.
ai2_live_note: Only the selected scope is sent; suggestions apply only when you accept them.

settings_appearance_desc: How the site looks. Your CV's colour and font are set in the editor's Appearance tab.
settings_dark_hint: CV pages always show as white paper.
settings_accent_hint: Buttons and selected items use this colour.
settings_language_hint: Used for menus and buttons. Each CV keeps its own language.
settings_data_desc: There's no server: your CVs live only in this browser, at this address. A backup file is both a safety net and the way to move to another computer.
settings_restore_hint: Choose a CVeditör JSON backup file. Your existing CVs aren't deleted.
settings_persist_on: The browser has confirmed it won't delete this site's data when space runs low.
settings_persist_off: The browser may delete data when space runs low. Try asking for permission, and keep backups anyway.
settings_persist_unknown: This browser doesn't report persistent storage status.
settings_persist_denied: The browser didn't grant permission. Remember to back up regularly.
settings_brave_note: In Brave, shield settings such as "forget me when I close this site", or clearing browser data, also delete your CVs. And if the address changes (e.g. a different port or the live site), your CVs won't show up; use a backup file to move them.
settings_browser_desc: A PDF that matches the preview exactly is guaranteed in Chromium-based browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave).
settings_browser_ok: You're using a Chromium-based browser; preview and PDF match exactly.
settings_browser_warn: This browser isn't Chromium-based. The site works, but line breaks in the PDF may differ slightly from the preview. For best results, use Chrome, Edge or Brave.
clear_desc: All CVs and backup info in this browser are deleted. This can't be undone.
clear_row_hint: We recommend making a backup first.
clear_check: I understand all my CVs will be permanently deleted from this browser.
settings_about_body: CVeditör {version}. Open source, MIT licensed. Your CVs are stored only in this browser. For now, PDFs are made with the browser's print dialog.
